## Cross-repo mesh — `herdr-plugin`

**Herdr integration**, one package of [`createos-plugin`](https://github.com/NodeOps-app/createos-plugin). Runs the agent inside the box and attaches a PTY to a Herdr pane; shells both the `createos` and `herdr` CLIs.

### What ripples into this package

A renamed or removed `createos` command or flag breaks this package **silently** — nothing type-checks across a shell boundary. Check this package before shipping a CLI change.

User-visible changes here are documented at `Integrations/Herdr` in [`createos-v2-landing`](https://github.com/NodeOps-app/createos-v2-landing). Keep the two in step.

The full repo graph, what counts as a shared surface, and the ripple
protocol live in the monorepo root [`CLAUDE.md`](../../CLAUDE.md), which is
loaded automatically from this directory.
